planets.name: Kepler-560 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-560 with a 18.5-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-560 b was found in 2016 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-560. Its orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MORTON_ET_AL__2016): disc_year 2016, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 18.47763641, pl_radj 0.15344812, pl_bmassj 0.0113

quotes.title: Kepler-560b
quotes.card: Kepler-560b, also called Kepler-560 Bb, is a confirmed exoplanet orbiting the secondary star of the binary star system Kepler-560.
